params.name: Two fresh runs: price processing
params.explanation:
Two fresh JVMs: processed count resets to 0, then price 40 is processed as count 1.
Child audit values are sparse; no value at filter 9 is not itself proof of no state change.
External sink totals are host callback measurements, timestamped just after each input.
params.rationale: Compare the exact scenario twice using raw audit and independent sink callback counts.

notes.text: Filter 9: no child audit values. Host measurement remains count=1, price=10, sinks=1.
Paused price 30 reaches Child; logged count=1 and last price=10.
Reset logs count=0, price=0, paused=false. Host sink total remains 1.
Fresh JVM D starts at count=0, last price=0; the scenario repeats.

sections.text: Measurement sources: project/acceptance-evidence/run-c and run-d contain audit.yaml, state.csv and checked.csv; sibling run-c.stdout.txt and run-d.stdout.txt record PIDs and assertion results.
